meta.tier: heuristic (方向性参考; v1 anchors/ret_propagated_types.json 为严格层)
meta.relaxation: v1 requires the intersection of ALL typed destination type-sets to be non-empty; v2 groups evidence by destination: each destination votes with the intersection of its own source sets (internally-contradictory destinations abstain), the winner set W = {t : support(t) >= 2/3 of voters} is asserted iff W non-empty AND no non-supporting destination crosses a hard family boundary (int-family vs float-family vs pointer/class/array) against W — same-family spelling-level minorities are tolerated; single voter => its set verbatim (v2 is a strict superset of v1).
meta.soundness: heuristic layer: majority vote is directional evidence, not a binary necessity — a 2/3 majority can outvote a genuine minority consumer; the three v1 guards are retained and applied to W (returns-this identity vs int-only winner; partial-register return gate requires W to intersect the bool/char family; array-only winner discarded); S-eq channel stays dropped (unsound by construction, see v1); types spelled verbatim from source anchors; deterministic double-run sha256-identical.

vs_v1.verdict: the >=2/3-majority relaxation recovers ZERO rows: all 13 v1-inconsistent discards decompose into 4 single-destination internally-contradictory candidates (abstain) + 8 sub-2/3 splits (50/50 or 1-of-N disjoint) + 1 cross-family minority (2x{unsigned int} vs {char[28]} at RET:43EF90) — genuine multi-value-domain returns / dirty-upper-bit artifacts, not majority-recoverable noise. The binding constraints are structural: 6,577/7,059 (93.2%) RET entities have zero typed destinations, and the partial-register-return gate accounts for 235/258 (91%) of candidate discards.
